_README: Every editorial-desk adjustment to a chart, with a written reason.
The editorial desk is 10% of a chart position, and EVERY change needs a
one-line reason recorded here. An entry with no reason has NO effect —
that is enforced in scripts/chart_engine.py, not left to good intent.
This log is public so that anyone can see exactly where human judgement
chart_week  the tracking week's Friday, YYYY-MM-DD
reason      one line, plain English, required

_template.reason: REQUIRED — one line explaining the change
